sentences.text:
Lakhan Chakraverti vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 June,
2015
 Crr-1181-2015
 (Lakhan Chakraverti Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh)
04-06-2015
Shri Ashok Chakravarti, learned counsel for the
applicant.
Shri Amit Seth, learned Govt. Advocate for the
respondent/State.
Heard on the application for urgent hearing the matter during summer vacation.
On due consideration, the application is allowed.
Also heard on the question of admission.
Also heard on I.A. No.10624/2015, which is an application for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to appellant.

The appellant has been convicted under Sections 7(1) read with Section 16(1)(A)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and has been sentenced to undergo RI for six months and fine of Rs. 1,000/-
with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
He has already suffered the jail sentence of about one month.
Revision would take considerable time for its conclusion, therefore, he prays for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the nature of sentence awarded to the applicant, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the jail sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail subject to condition that he shall deposit the fine amount, if any, and furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 30/6/2015 and on such other subsequent dates as may be given in this behalf.
List for final hearing in due course.

(VANDANA KASREKAR) JUDGE Lakhan Chakraverti vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 June, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49674524/
